name: process.guaranteed_waitlist
steps: Students whose room accommodations have not yet been assigned are placed on the guaranteed waitlist and emailed weekly about their waitlist status until the housing assignment is finalized; housing confirmations (a building and room, or the guaranteed waitlist) begin in mid-June.

name: process.selection_options
steps: Same Area and Open Room Selection

name: process.spring_selection_description
steps: Spring Housing Selection for Rising Sophomores is when students receive a timeslot to reserve a room in an upper-level residence hall or house.
